attacks.name: Repulsor Mk 2
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
After this attack is resolved, if it did not deal |!damage|, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Push|: Before |!damage| is dealt, Push the defender Away |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Billion-Dollar Punch
steps: Before |!damage| is dealt, Place this character within |!range| 1 of the defender.
|!wild| |!hit| |*Throw|: After this attack is resolved, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, this character Throws it Away |!movement_medium|.

attacks.name: Focused Unibeam
steps: When rolling additional dice for |!critical| results during this attack, roll 2 additional dice instead of 1 for each |!critical| in the attack roll.
After this attack is resolved, if the attack roll contains any |!critical| results, this character suffers 2 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: Let‘s Get You An Upgrade (Affiliation: S.H.I.E.L.D.)
superPowers.body: While an allied character is attacking, defending, or dodging, during the |*Modify Dice| step, it may spend 1 |!power|. If it does, it may reroll 1 of its dice.

superPowers.name: J.A.R.V.I.S.
superPowers.body: While another allied character within |!range| 4 is attacking, during the |*Modify Dice| step of the attack, this character may spend 1 - 3 |!power| to use this superpower. For each |!power| spent, the allied character may reroll 1 of its attack dice.

superPowers.name: I Am Iron Man
superPowers.body: If this character would suffer |!damage| from an enemy effect, it may use this superpower. Reduce the amount of |!damage| suffered by 1.
